Lemma
[The Jacobi equation] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0305, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0306 ↗ appb-def-jacobi-field 1. Lemma B.13\group local-comparison-geometry

A field $J$ along a geodesic with unit tangent vector $T$ is a Jacobi field if and only if \[ abla _T abla _T J = R(T,J)T. \]
